about: Measured wall time of each Studio test file, in milliseconds: its tests plus its imports and hooks. From the logs of the green studio.yml run 40742666274 on main (attempt 2, commit 759defe, 2026-10-28): windows from the twelve test (windows-latest) shard jobs, macos from build (macos-latest). realWorkerTests.ts deals the blocking suite's files into shards by these times (windows on Windows, macos elsewhere); a file that is not listed is dealt by count. A file's time is the span between its ##[group] and ##[endgroup] lines in a job log; refresh both maps from a newer green run once the suite has moved.
